verdict.rationale: Weave's @weave.op() decorator automatically captures code, inputs, outputs, and execution metadata for LLM calls, with automatic token usage and cost tracking recorded per call and displayed in the trace tree/UI. Latency is inherently part of the captured trace/execution metadata; OTel-compatible import and GitHub docs corroborate first-party and independent-style evidence. Missing for 10: explicit standalone documentation calling out latency capture by name, and independent (non-vendor) hands-on validation.
